name: onResourceStart

params.name: resourceName
params.description: Name of the resource that has just started.

description: Raised immediately after a resource has started, on the server and on each client running it. Raised for every resource, so compare `resourceName` with `GetCurrentResourceName()` to react to your own start.

name: onResourceStarting

params.name: resourceName
params.description: Name of the resource that is about to start.

description: Raised when a resource is trying to start. Calling `CancelEvent()` prevents the resource from starting.

name: onResourceStop

params.name: resourceName
params.description: Name of the resource that is stopping.

description: Raised immediately when a resource is stopping, on the server and on each client running it. Use it to clean up what your resource created (entities, blips, NUI focus).

name: onClientResourceStart

params.name: resourceName
params.description: Name of the resource that has started.

description: Queued on the client after a resource has started there.

name: onClientResourceStop

params.name: resourceName
params.description: Name of the resource that has stopped.

description: Raised on the client after a resource has stopped there.

name: onServerResourceStart

params.name: resourceName
params.description: Name of the resource that has started.

description: Queued on the server after a resource has started.

name: onServerResourceStop

params.name: resourceName
params.description: Name of the resource that has stopped.

description: Raised on the server after a resource has stopped.

name: onResourceListRefresh
description: Raised on the server when the `refresh` console command has finished rescanning the resources.

name: playerConnecting

params.name: playerName
params.description: Display name of the connecting player.

params.name: setKickReason
params.description: fun(reason: string). Sets the message shown to the player when the event is canceled.

params.name: deferrals
params.description: Deferral control object with `defer()`, `update(message)`, `presentCard(card, cb)`, `done(failureReason)` and `handover(data)`. Wait at least one tick after `defer()` before calling the others.

description: Raised when a player tries to connect. `source` is a temporary id usable with a limited set of functions. Cancel the event (before yielding) to refuse the player, or use deferrals to accept or refuse later, for example after a database query.

name: playerJoining

params.name: oldID
params.description: The temporary id the player had during `playerConnecting`.

description: Raised when a connecting player receives their final server id, available as `source`.

name: playerDropped

params.name: reason
params.description: Why the player disconnected.

params.name: resourceName
params.description: The resource the drop was dispatched from.

params.name: clientDropReason
params.description: Internal drop reason code (see ClientDropReasons.h in the FiveM sources).

description: Raised when a player leaves the server. `source` is the player who left; clean up per-player data here.

name: playerEnteredScope

params.name: data
params.description: Table with `player` (the player entering the scope) and `for` (the player whose scope is entered), both server ids as strings. Read `for` as `data['for']` since `for` is a Lua keyword.

description: OneSync: raised when a player enters another player's scope (becomes relevant to them).

name: playerLeftScope

params.name: data
params.description: Table with `player` (the player leaving the scope) and `for` (the player whose scope is left), both server ids as strings. Read `for` as `data['for']`.

description: OneSync: raised when a player leaves another player's scope.

name: onPlayerBucketChange

params.name: player
params.description: Server id of the player that changed routing bucket.

params.name: bucket
params.description: The new routing bucket.

params.name: oldBucket
params.description: The previous routing bucket.

description: Raised when a player is moved to another routing bucket.

name: onEntityBucketChange

params.name: entity
params.description: Handle of the entity that changed routing bucket.

params.name: bucket
params.description: The new routing bucket.

params.name: oldBucket
params.description: The previous routing bucket.

description: Raised when an entity is moved to another routing bucket.

name: entityCreating

params.name: entity
params.description: Server handle of the entity being created.

description: OneSync: raised while a networked entity is being created. Calling `CancelEvent()` deletes the entity immediately, which is useful to block unwanted models.

name: entityCreated

params.name: entity
params.description: Server handle of the created entity.

description: OneSync: queued after a networked entity has been created and accepted.

name: entityRemoved

params.name: entity
params.description: Server handle of the entity that was removed.

description: OneSync: raised when a networked entity is removed on the server.

name: weaponDamageEvent

params.name: sender
params.description: Server id of the player that sent the event, as a string.

params.name: data
params.description: Damage data, including `damageType`, `weaponType` (weapon hash), `weaponDamage`, `overrideDefaultDamage`, `hitGlobalId` (network id of the victim), `hitGlobalIds`, `willKill`, `silenced`, `damageTime`, `damageFlags`, `hitComponent`, `localPosX/Y/Z`, `parentGlobalId`. The exact field set differs between FiveM and RedM.

description: OneSync: raised when a client wants to apply damage to an entity owned by someone else. Canceling it stops the damage from being forwarded.

name: explosionEvent

params.name: sender
params.description: Server id of the player that sent the event, as a string.

params.name: data
params.description: Explosion data, including `explosionType`, `posX`, `posY`, `posZ`, `ownerNetId` (reported by the client, can be spoofed), `damageScale`, `cameraShake`, `isAudible`, `isInvisible`. Additional fields differ between FiveM and RedM.

description: OneSync: raised when a client reports an explosion. Canceling it stops the explosion from being forwarded to other players.

name: startProjectileEvent

params.name: sender
params.description: Server id of the player that sent the event, as a string.

params.name: data
params.description: Projectile data, including `ownerId`, `projectileHash`, `weaponHash`, `initialPositionX/Y/Z`, `firePositionX/Y/Z`, `targetEntity`, `effectGroup`, `throwTaskSequence`. Additional fields differ between FiveM and RedM.

description: OneSync: raised when a client creates a projectile. Canceling it stops the event from being forwarded.

name: clearPedTasksEvent

params.name: sender
params.description: Server id of the player that sent the event, as a string.

params.name: data
params.description: Table with `pedId` (network id of the ped) and `immediately` (whether the tasks are cleared immediately).

description: OneSync: raised when a client clears the tasks of a ped it does not own. Canceling it stops the request from being forwarded.

name: respawnPlayerPedEvent

params.name: sender
params.description: Server id of the player that respawned, as a string.

params.name: data
params.description: Respawn data, including `posX`, `posY`, `posZ`; the other fields are not named.

description: OneSync: raised when a player respawns. Canceling it stops the event from being forwarded.

name: ptFxEvent

params.name: sender
params.description: Server id of the player that sent the event, as a string.

params.name: data
params.description: Particle effect data, including `effectHash`, `assetHash`, `posX/Y/Z`, `offsetX/Y/Z`, `rotX/Y/Z`, `scale`, `axisBitset`, `isOnEntity`, `entityNetId`.

description: OneSync: raised when a client creates a networked particle effect. Canceling it stops the effect from being forwarded.

name: giveWeaponEvent

params.name: sender
params.description: Server id of the player that sent the event, as a string.

params.name: data
params.description: Table with `pedId` (network id of the ped), `weaponType` (weapon hash), `ammo`, `givenAsPickup` and `unk1`.

description: OneSync: raised when a client gives a weapon to a ped owned by another player. Canceling it stops the event from being forwarded.

name: removeWeaponEvent

params.name: sender
params.description: Server id of the player that sent the event, as a string.

params.name: data
params.description: Table with `pedId` (network id of the ped) and `weaponType` (weapon hash).

description: OneSync: raised when a client removes a weapon from a ped owned by another player. Canceling it stops the event from being forwarded.

name: removeAllWeaponsEvent

params.name: sender
params.description: Server id of the player that sent the event, as a string.

params.name: data
params.description: Table with `pedId` (network id of the ped).

description: OneSync: raised when a client removes all weapons from a ped owned by another player. Canceling it stops the event from being forwarded.

name: fireEvent

params.name: sender
params.description: Server id of the player that sent the event, as a string.

params.name: data
params.description: An array whose first element is the list of fires. Each fire has fields such as `posX`, `posY`, `posZ`, `isEntity`, `entityGlobalId`, `maxChildren`, `weaponHash` and `fireId`.

description: OneSync: raised when a client starts one or more fires. Canceling it stops the event from being forwarded.

name: vehicleComponentControlEvent

params.name: sender
params.description: Server id of the player that sent the event, as a string.

params.name: data
params.description: Table with `vehicleGlobalId`, `pedGlobalId`, `componentIndex`, `request`, `componentIsSeat` and `pedInSeat`.

description: OneSync: raised when a ped requests control of a vehicle component (a seat, for example). Canceling it stops the event from being forwarded.

name: givePedScriptedTaskEvent

params.name: sender
params.description: Server id of the player that sent the event, as a string.

params.name: data
params.description: Table with `entityNetId` (network id of the ped) and `taskId`.

description: OneSync: raised when a client gives a scripted task to a ped owned by another player. Canceling it stops the event from being forwarded.

name: requestNetworkSyncedSceneEvent

params.name: sender
params.description: Server id of the player that sent the event, as a string.

params.name: data
params.description: Table with `sceneId`.

description: OneSync: raised when a client requests a networked synchronized scene. Canceling it stops the event from being forwarded.

name: startNetworkSyncedSceneEvent

params.name: sender
params.description: Server id of the player that sent the event, as a string.

params.name: data
params.description: Scene data, including `sceneId`, `startTime`, `scenePosX/Y/Z`, `sceneRotX/Y/Z/W`, `rate`, `isLooped`, `holdLastFrame`, `animDictHash`, `pedEntities`, `nonPedEntities`, `mapEntities`.

description: OneSync: raised when a client starts a networked synchronized scene. Canceling it stops the event from being forwarded.

name: updateNetworkSyncedSceneEvent

params.name: sender
params.description: Server id of the player that sent the event, as a string.

params.name: data
params.description: Table with `sceneId` and `rate`.

description: OneSync: raised when a client updates the rate of a networked synchronized scene. Canceling it stops the event from being forwarded.

name: stopNetworkSyncedSceneEvent

params.name: sender
params.description: Server id of the player that sent the event, as a string.

params.name: data
params.description: Table with `sceneId`.

description: OneSync: raised when a client stops a networked synchronized scene. Canceling it stops the event from being forwarded.

name: lightningEvent

params.name: sender
params.description: Server id of the player that sent the event, as a string.

params.name: data
params.description: Lightning data; its fields are not named yet.

description: OneSync (RedM): raised when a client triggers a lightning strike. Canceling it stops the event from being forwarded.

name: endLootEvent

params.name: sender
params.description: Server id of the player that sent the event, as a string.

params.name: data
params.description: Table with `targetId` and unnamed fields.

description: OneSync (RedM): raised when a client finishes looting. Canceling it stops the event from being forwarded.

name: sendCarriableUpdateCarryStateEvent

params.name: sender
params.description: Server id of the player that sent the event, as a string.

params.name: data
params.description: Table with `carriableId`, `parentId` and `carrierId`.

description: OneSync (RedM): raised when the carry state of a carriable entity changes. Canceling it stops the event from being forwarded.

name: carriableVehicleStowStartEvent

params.name: sender
params.description: Server id of the player that sent the event, as a string.

params.name: data
params.description: Table with `carrierId`, `carriableId` and `vehicleId`.

description: OneSync (RedM): raised when stowing a carriable entity on a vehicle starts. Canceling it stops the event from being forwarded.

name: carriableVehicleStowCompleteEvent

params.name: sender
params.description: Server id of the player that sent the event, as a string.

params.name: data
params.description: Table with `carrierId`, `vehicleId`, `carriableId`, `posX`, `posY`, `posZ` and unnamed fields.

description: OneSync (RedM): raised when stowing a carriable entity on a vehicle completes. Canceling it stops the event from being forwarded.

name: pickupCarriableEvent

params.name: sender
params.description: Server id of the player that sent the event, as a string.

params.name: data
params.description: Table with `carrierId`, `carriableId`, `parentId` and an unnamed field.

description: OneSync (RedM): raised when a carriable entity is picked up. Canceling it stops the event from being forwarded.

name: placeCarriableOntoParentEvent

params.name: sender
params.description: Server id of the player that sent the event, as a string.

params.name: data
params.description: Table with `carrierId`, `carriableId`, `parentId` and unnamed fields.

description: OneSync (RedM): raised when a carriable entity is placed onto a parent (a horse or a vehicle, for example). Canceling it stops the event from being forwarded.

name: rconCommand

params.name: command
params.description: Name of the command executed over RCON.

params.name: args
params.description: List of the arguments passed to the command.

description: Deprecated: raised for commands executed over RCON. Use `RegisterCommand` with the `restricted` flag instead.

name: chatMessage

params.name: source
params.description: Server id of the player who sent the message (passed as a regular argument).

params.name: author
params.description: Name shown as the message author.

params.name: text
params.description: The message text.

description: Provided by the default `chat` resource: raised on the server for each chat message before it is broadcast. Canceling it prevents the broadcast.

name: chat:addSuggestion

params.name: name
params.description: Command name including the leading slash, for example `/heal`.

params.name: help
params.description: Help text shown for the command.

params.name: params
params.description: Optional list of parameters, each a table with `name` and `help`.

description: Provided by the default `chat` resource: trigger it on the client with `TriggerEvent` to add a command suggestion to the chat box.

name: chat:removeSuggestion

params.name: name
params.description: Command name including the leading slash.

description: Provided by the default `chat` resource: removes a command suggestion previously added with `chat:addSuggestion`.

name: chat:addMessage

params.name: message
params.description: Message table, for example `{ color = { r, g, b }, args = { 'Author', 'Text' } }`.

description: Provided by the default `chat` resource: adds a message to the chat box. Trigger it locally with `TriggerEvent`, or from the server with `TriggerClientEvent` (target `-1` for everyone).

name: gameEventTriggered

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the game event, for example `CEventNetworkEntityDamage`.

params.name: args
params.description: Event-specific integer data.

description: Raised on the client after low-level game events, such as network entity damage. Not raised in RedM.

name: entityDamaged

params.name: victim
params.description: The damaged entity, or 0.

params.name: culprit
params.description: The entity that caused the damage, or 0.

params.name: weapon
params.description: Hash of the weapon that inflicted the damage.

params.name: baseDamage
params.description: Base damage before modifiers.

description: Raised on the client when an entity is damaged locally. Not raised in RedM.

name: populationPedCreating

params.name: x
params.description: X position where the ped will spawn.

params.name: y
params.description: Y position.

params.name: z
params.description: Z position.

params.name: model
params.description: Hash of the model the ped will use.

params.name: setters
params.description: Table with `setModel(model)` (hash or name) and `setPosition(x, y, z)` to change the ped before it is created.

description: Raised on the client before the population system creates an ambient ped. Change it with the setters, or call `CancelEvent()` to skip it.

name: __cfx_nui:*

params.name: data
params.description: Decoded JSON body posted by the NUI page.

params.name: cb
params.description: Callback that sends the response back to the page. Always call it.

description: Internal event pattern used by `RegisterNUICallback(name, fn)`: a POST from the resource's NUI page to `https://<resource>/<name>` raises `__cfx_nui:<name>`. Register NUI callbacks with `RegisterNUICallback` rather than handling this event directly.
